notes.title: Rising Islands update 1.013 Patch - #3
notes.notes:
Hello!

I hope that you are all doing great and feeling good. We have been hard at work to improve upon the time trial mode of the game and have restructured it from the ground up under the hood to make it work much smoother. 

For this patch we have also looked at feedback we have received from the community regarding some levels that could be more streamlined with some tweaks.

- Reworked Time trial
- Fixed an iceblock sticking out too much on Slippery Slopes
- Hairo sitting too low in main menu
- General level tweaks
- Minor text fixes

Until next time,

- The Lone Hero Team

notes.title: Rising Islands update 1.011 - Patch #2
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We are so happy that people are now able to play and enjoy the game. To make the experience smoother we have adressed some bugs that popped up. The patch fixes are:

- Fixed a bug where skipping a cutscene would only pause the video.
- Fixed a bug where localization did not save properly
- Fixed potholes in world 3 where player could get stuck.

Thank you for all the continued support and feedback.

- The Lone Hero Team

notes.title: Rising Islands update 1.010 - Release update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

The day is upon us when we release Rising Islands to the world. We have listened to the feedback from our early testers and these are the updates for the release build.

- Updated 2D cutscenes
- Fixed Time trial showing collectibles at end
- Fixed Time trial not showing restart option if lose cutscene is skipped
- Fixed a bug where the player could infinitely wallrun 
- Fixed checkpoints that spawned Hairo in the middle of nowhere
- Filled a hole where Hairo could get stuck in the tutorial level
- Credits fixed at the end of the game
- Minor text fixes

Thank you for all the support and feedback! 

- The Lone Hero Team
